direct_block: The residual twist of the chosen lattice must be absolutely irreducible. Our residual semisimplification on G_E is the sum of three characters, so any residual lattice representation has proper submodules; scalar twists and finite coefficient extensions do not change that failure. Characteristic-zero strong irreducibility or full SL3 closure does not discharge residual irreducibility.
other_missing_input: The theorem also assumes the Euler-system projection is nonzero. No comparison identifies that class or its quotient with the unsquared odd source conormal or the ordinary-normalized mixed obstruction here.
conclusion: This exact Euler-system bound cannot be directly applied at our residually Tate Eisenstein point. No exclusion of other Euler-system methods, no claim of evaluated obstruction, and no main arithmetic movement.
